text: 午后，多只宽基ETF成交额再度拉升，科创50ETF华夏（588000）、创业板ETF易方达（159915）、沪深300ETF华泰柏瑞（510300）成交额均突破100亿元。
text_en: In the afternoon, turnover in several broad-based ETFs rose again, with ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF (588000), E Fund ChiNext ETF (159915) and Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF (510300) all exceeding RMB 10 billion in turnover.
